statement: These thresholds were frozen BEFORE any R15-trained checkpoint existed and before any VLA DEV prediction was computed. They are not to be adjusted after seeing a VLA DEV score.

dev_cohort.frame_rule: history-safe t in [2, T-2], deterministically chosen

conditions: loss finite at every recorded step
every decoded 14D command inside the joint box
a clear signal over the zero-step model and over identity A=S: DEV macro L1 must be strictly lower than identity_A=S macro L1 (0.007733860024018213)
no total collapse: still_action_rate < 1.0 and magnitude_ratio within [0.2, 5.0]
G4_300.action_if_fail: stop formal training, diagnose (labels/shift/vision/grad/lr), do not add steps

conditions: DEV macro physical L1 improves at least 5 percent versus constant velocity (target <= 0.002005 from 0.002110)
OR the same 5% test passes in at least 3 of 4 pre-registered motion strata (strata are the DEV |V| quartiles of the frozen gate frames)
magnitude ratio and sign agreement not worse than CV by more than 20 percent
G5_1000.action_if_fail: stop at 1000, keep the checkpoint, diagnose; never train to 3000 blindly

conditions: same-sample fair metrics for every reported stage
the reported checkpoint is the DEV-best among 300/1000/3000
the new FINAL data remains untouched
G6_3000.action_if_fail: report FAILED_CAPABILITY with the real numbers

notes: Offline L1 is not the closed-loop success rate.
constant velocity is a strong baseline on Push-T; a model that cannot beat it has not learned the task.
